figures.finding: Puerto Rico's labour relations fall under US federal law: the US National Labor Relations Board's Region 12 covers it, so performers', writers' and directors' unions and agreements there are those of the US system; no Puerto Rican agreement of its own setting an actor's, writer's or director's pay was found.
